verdict.rationale: Supabase ships its own AI Assistant inside the Dashboard for database management. It also offers an official hosted MCP server and plugin, so AI assistants can query the database, manage migrations and deploy Edge Functions on the user's behalf, and a runtime probe confirms the MCP endpoint is live with OAuth. Prompt-injection concerns raised by the community bear on security, not on whether natural-language operation works, so they are not treated as a dispute. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of which natural-language commands the Dashboard AI Assistant can execute, and independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Supabase AI Assistant is integrated into the Supabase Dashboard to drastically improve your database management experience.
The AI Assistant can save you hours of work by automating repetitive tasks and providing context-aware support.
Once connected, your AI assistants can interact with and query your Supabase projects on your behalf.
your agent can query your database, manage migrations, deploy Edge Functions, and follow Supabase and Postgres best practices — without manual configuration
the documented remote MCP endpoint is live and speaks the MCP OAuth flow
